inflection_why_now: The recent advancements in high-stress silicon nitride membranes have enabled unprecedented sensitivity in room-temperature force and displacement measurements, positioning COMPACT-Q at the forefront of sensor technology innovation.
devils_advocate_risks: The commercialization of highly sensitive sensor technologies often faces challenges in scaling production and ensuring reliability for diverse applications.
Securing adequate funding and strategic partnerships is crucial for transitioning from research to market-ready products, and any delays or difficulties in this process could impede growth.
